guide.overview:
DHA Lahore is the Defence Housing Authority's city in Lahore, east and south-east of Lahore Cantt and the airport. It is laid out in numbered phases — 1 to 13 — each divided into lettered sectors and blocks, with DHA Rahbar (Phase 11) and the EME Sector on the city's south-western side.

Phases

Phases 1 to 6 are the established, fully built part of DHA, around the Defence Clubs in J-Sector and R-Sector and the main boulevards. Phase 7 and Phase 8 — with Ivy Green, Park View, Air Avenue and the Leminscate Club — are where most new houses are going up. Phase 9 Prism lies along the Ring Road, and Phase 9 Town, Phase 10, Phase 11 (Rahbar) and Phase 13 are the newer phases.

Plot sizes

Residential plots are mostly 5 and 10 marla and 1 and 2 kanal, with commercial plots in each phase's markets and commercial broadways.

Buying in DHA Lahore

Every plot and house is a DHA file: check its phase, sector, size and dues, and transfer it through the DHA office. Open a phase below for its map, prices and the houses and plots for sale and rent.

faqs.q: How many phases does DHA Lahore have?
faqs.a: DHA Lahore is laid out in Phases 1 to 13, with DHA Rahbar (Phase 11) and the EME Sector. Each phase is divided into lettered sectors and blocks.

faqs.q: Which DHA Lahore phases are fully developed?
faqs.a: Phases 1 to 6 are fully built and lived in, and Phases 7 and 8 have possession with houses going up fast. Phase 9 Prism, Phase 10, Rahbar and Phase 13 are newer.

faqs.q: Where is the DHA Lahore head office?
faqs.a: In Sector A, Phase 6, DHA Lahore. Its helpline is 042-111-342-547 and its website is dhalahore.org.

faqs.q: What plot sizes are in DHA Lahore?
faqs.a: Mostly 5 and 10 marla and 1 and 2 kanal residential plots, with commercial plots in every phase.
